long_description.before:
Broccoli is building the AI-native operating system for home service businesses. Running a plumbing or HVAC company is chaotic: calls, scheduling, dispatch, follow-ups, marketing. We automate all of it so contractors can focus on what they do best: serving customers.

Our AI agents handle both revenue and ops; answering phones 24/7, booking jobs in real time, following up on leads, and alerting techs when emergencies hit.

We’ve grown from 0 to 800+ contractors in under 2 years, raised Series A round led by Khosla Ventures to take on one of the biggest labor automation opportunities in the country.

AJ and Adi have worked together for the past nine years, building multiple startups. AJ, a Computer Science graduate, started his career at Adobe before moving into entrepreneurship. Adi, also a Computer Science graduate, conducted research at the renowned CVC lab at UAB Barcelona before joining Microsoft. Together, they founded Telematica and later Broccoli.

long_description.before: BiggerPicture is a B2B SaaS solution that automates the scheduling of pick-up and delivery times for trucking companies and warehouses. 75% of shipments are still scheduled over phone calls and emails.
long_description.after:
BiggerPicture, Inc. runs the largest freight scheduling network in the industry.

It is a freight appointment network. Carriers, shippers, and facilities work from one shared shipment record, so the appointment a carrier requests is the same appointment the facility confirms and the shipper sees. Nothing to reconcile between systems, no email threads to chase.

One workspace covers every scheduling channel: email, bulk email, and direct portal integrations. Automation handles routine booking and routes anything that needs a human into an exception queue. Every party is graded on one shared, published compliance standard rather than each provider's own unpublished metrics.

Some of the largest brokers and carriers in the country run on our network. SOC 2 Type II. Women-led.

one_liner.before: Scheduling automation platform between trucking and warehousing
one_liner.after: The largest freight scheduling network in the industry.

long_description.before:
Centauri AI is a modern ETL and Data Science platform for banks and investment firms, starting with Structured Finance. 

Financial firms heavily rely on Excel, PDF, and PPT files to exchange complex asset details, leading analysts to spend hours crunching the files and extracting insights. Moreover, these data files and reports cannot be easily reused due to poor data infrastructure. 

Powered by AI, our product cuts hours of data wrangling work down to minutes and makes it possible to query past data easily. This helps firms evaluate assets faster and win more deals.

Since launching last month, we've started a pilot with a brokerage team at a public investment bank that now uses our product daily. Aiming to serve over 100,000 investment teams needing complex data analysis for alternative investments, this opens up a potential $5 billion market.

long_description.before:
Golpo AI is the world's best platform to create fully produced whiteboard explainer videos from just a prompt or document. Instead of hiring an agency, you simply input a prompt or document explaining what you want, and in minutes you get a whiteboard explainer video in a style similar to Khan Academy or RSA Animate. After creation, you have the ability to edit all aspects of the video with just prompts. 

It's perfect for training, faceless YouTube, marketing, technical, and educational videos — any video where understanding is important. Trusted by over 150,000 users as of July '26, Golpo features include but are not limited to: 

1) Convert your narration into an explainer video (with your narration as audio and the video time aligned) 
2) Input your document or prompt. Document can be of virtually any format or type (text, audio, video etc.) 
3) Script-to-video with matching audio
4) Videos up to 10 minutes
5) 50+ languages
6) dead-simple editing after generation
7) Insert your own videos and images into the generation, used as-is without alteration.
8) 10+ visuals styles, including pen in hand, voice cloning, vertical video, custom branding and more! API access available.

Home services companies lose money on missed calls and idle techs. When the phone rings during a job and nobody picks up, that lead goes to a competitor and the trucks already on the road sit half-booked because dispatch can't keep the schedule tight.

CentralComs fixes this with AI agents that answer every call, route each job to the right technician, and keep the calendar full. They handle intake, dispatch, and customer updates end to end working inside ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, and Jobber so no lead slips through and no truck runs empty.

long_description.before:
Exosat is building thousands of low-cost communication satellites to provide a neutral, sovereign alternative to Starlink. By building our satellites with zero ITAR/EAR-controlled content, we can leverage manufacturers anywhere in the world to produce our satellites at under a tenth of the cost and launch them from any nation to bypass launch capacity bottlenecks.

We're starting off by selling connectivity to device OEMs and network operators, but will eventually use the distributed compute across our constellation to run low-latency inference for robots and autonomous vehicles in remote and rural areas anywhere on the planet.

We've already signed $400M+ in LOIs to work with operators across Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, booked our first satellite launch next year, and hold an 11,000 satellite filing with the ITU to build the largest comms network outside of the U.S. and China.
